clauses.title: CL-D101 records that the launch names a verification request
clauses.section: ## CL-D101 — The gate launch names a verification request; the child copies no digest
requires: carrying the request's path exactly once and neither the payload's path nor its digest
Putting a digest or a hash prefix back into the launch text, or letting a gate proceed without `gate_payload_verify`, requires a new owner decision.

clauses.title: The pointer runs the request file and the request is staged and renamed
The helper map names both writes of the launch builder
requires: are the gate payload file and its verification request beside that expectation file
its request carries only a pointer to that request (CL-D91, CL-D101)

clauses.title: CL-D91 names the later rule
clauses.section: ## CL-D91 — The gate launch carries a pointer to a verified payload file
requires: CL-D101 later took the path and the digest out of the pointer

clauses.title: CL-D68 names the second write
clauses.section: ## CL-D68 — The gate launch request and the designated-output read are packaged
requires: the composer's one write until CL-D101 added the verification request beside it

clauses.title: The digest-free pointer is pinned

no hash or hash prefix for the child to copy
